steps.text: From the repo root:
steps.code:
npm run verify
npm run check-modules
npm run catalog-sync

steps.text: Immediate exit / node:sqlite errors → upgrade Node to 22.13+
Port in use → change db_port or DB_PORT
Module API errors → verify modulesDir and SFMC_ROOT
Corrupt SQLite → stop services and restore from backup
Health check:

nodes.title: Load gate / BDS did not start

steps.text: Check the load summary and <SFMC_ROOT>/.sfmc/logs/
Run mod build and confirm esbuild succeeds
In the monorepo, run npm run check-modules
Ensure inbox conflicts are not blocking the pre-start scan

nodes.title: Module enabled but no in-game effect

steps.text: Did you run mod reload or restart BDS?
Is enabled: true in modules/module-lock.json?
GET /api/sfmc/modules/<id> to confirm state
Temporarily mod disable the module to isolate it
Are dependency modules installed and enabled?
Tests must import the minecraft loader:
UnimplementedMinecraftApiError → narrow assertions or wait for deeper sandbox coverage
Assertion fails while BDS works → fidelity gap; verify with Watch / real BDS
Author workflow
LLBot reverse WS should be ws://127.0.0.1:3002
Verify qq_group_id and llbot_* settings
Check qq / llbot logs for a successful connection
Ensure the firewall allows port 3002
Build workspaces, then assemble packs:
steps.code:
npm run build --workspaces --if-present
sfmc> mod build

steps.text: Legacy import "@sfmc/sdk" needs a reinstall via current CLI, or a resolvable SDK
